title: Windows System Audio
description: Detected playback outputs and system-wide routing
backendDescription: Voxveil can use its native APO when loaded, its verified virtual endpoint, or standard VB-CABLE for system-wide processing.
vbCableMissing: Install the standard VB-CABLE virtual audio device to enable system-wide processing.
routeInstructionVbCable: Set CABLE Input as the Windows output, choose the physical destination below, then return to Voxveil.
routeInstructionVoxveilCable: Set Voxveil Input as the Windows output, choose the physical destination below, then return to Voxveil.
routeActive: System audio is being processed and sent to the selected physical output.
processingRouteDescription: Choose where Voxveil applies Classic DSP.
physicalApoDescription: Processes supported apps on a covered output. Requires Voxveil’s signed APO and never uses a virtual audio device. RAW, exclusive-mode, offloaded, or unsupported-format streams may bypass it.
physicalApoUnavailable: The physical APO route is selected. To use your installed VB-CABLE, select System-wide — automatic in Settings.
ownedPlaybackDescription: Processes only a local file opened here. Other apps play normally; no audio component is installed.
legacyAutomaticDescription: Uses Voxveil’s physical APO when loaded. Otherwise, routes Windows audio through VB-CABLE or Voxveil Virtual Cable to your selected physical output.
routeConfigError: Audio route settings need attention. Choose a route to replace the invalid saved value.
